title: Recognising the phone, not the throat: code for deconfounded evaluation and shortcut mitigation in smartphone pharyngitis classification
description: Code, fold assignments and out-of-fold predictions for a study of device and site shortcuts on the PGUPharyngitis dataset, including the shortcut_audit package (deconfounded AUC, covariate-adjusted AUC, LEACE concept erasure and site-leakage probes).
